notes.title: Our new game Hope for City is ready!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The big day is soon and we are ready for it!
Hope for City will be live on 16 September and we have a 40% big launch discount, valid for the first week!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1142360/Hope_for_City/

So, don’t miss out!

Also, don’t miss our new release trailer!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DD1w1sPMJgk
Hope For City is an Old-School RPG game. We designed this game for mini rpg & survival fans. Farming, crafting, combat, fishing, mini games and more, just explore it! Monsters, wild animals, orcs... Who do you think will win?


As always, thank you for your love and support.
We hope you all have fun, Cloaz Studio! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34745943/60de6077276e4583fc8a40a4b554738aa3b0cefe.png[/img]
